name: kahiniscope-production
description: Kahiniscope production task manager — Firebase backend and Expo app

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project kahiniscope-rules-test --only firestore "npm run test:rules:run"
scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules && npm run test:auth && npm run test:approval && npm run test:roles && npm run test:escalation && npm run test:contacts && npm run test:payments
scripts.test:auth: npm --prefix functions run build && OWNER_EMAILS=owner@kahiniscope.test firebase emulators:exec --project kahiniscope-demo --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:auth:run"
scripts.test:approval: npm --prefix functions run build && OWNER_EMAILS=owner@kahiniscope.test firebase emulators:exec --project kahiniscope-demo --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:approval:run"
scripts.test:roles: npm --prefix functions run build && OWNER_EMAILS=owner@kahiniscope.test firebase emulators:exec --project kahiniscope-demo --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:roles:run"
scripts.test:escalation: npm --prefix functions run build && OWNER_EMAILS=owner@kahiniscope.test ESCALATION_RUN_KEY=test-run-key firebase emulators:exec --project kahiniscope-demo --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:escalation:run"
scripts.test:contacts: npm --prefix functions run build && OWNER_EMAILS=owner@kahiniscope.test firebase emulators:exec --project kahiniscope-demo --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:contacts:run"
scripts.test:payments: npm --prefix functions run build && OWNER_EMAILS=owner@kahiniscope.test firebase emulators:exec --project kahiniscope-demo --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run test:payments:run"
